about.title: About & Contact
about.heading: Hi, I'm {ownerName}.
about.introduction: I'm a software engineer and game developer. I like building things from the ground up: engines, tools and the systems that make a game work.
paragraphs: Throughout my career I've worked on everything from embedded systems to large-scale platforms, always paying close attention to architecture and to the quality of what ships. Today I'm building my own engine, ByteForge, and I also work with Unreal, Unity and Godot.
I know the particulars of real-time applications well, where performance, memory and every millisecond of a frame matter, and I enjoy solving those problems end to end.
Music has been part of my life since I was 3, and I've been teaching since I was 12. Today it's also part of my game work, through soundtracks and sound effects.
Joining the game industry is a dream of mine, and I'm actively looking for that opportunity, in Brazil or abroad. If you're building a team, I'd love to talk.
